One-command HTML report of an HDX-MS comparison

Source: R/reporting.R
render_report.Rd

Renders an HTML report with the analysis parameters, the Masson et al. (2019) summary table (hdx_summary_table()), data-quality checks (peptide_qc() issues and the coverage map), significant-peptide counts and a fissure-vent plot for every time point and state compared with the reference, and - when given - region ANOVAs (compare_regions()) and whole-time-course results (compare_timecourse()). The tidy results table (hdx_results_table()) is written next to the report as csv, together with its parameters file.

Usage

render_report(
  filepath,
  output_file = "hdx_report.html",
  states = NULL,
  times = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  regions = NULL,
  alpha = 0.01,
  pvalue = 0.01,
  p_adjust = "none",
  percent = FALSE,
  metadata = list(),
  title = "HDX-MS report",
  Dfact = 0.85,
  protein_range = NULL
)

Arguments

filepath

input file or table, as for output_tp().

output_file

path of the HTML report. Default "hdx_report.html" in the working directory.

states, times, reference

states, time points and reference state (default: all states, all common time points, the first state).

regions

optional named list of c(start, end) residue ranges for compare_regions().

alpha, pvalue, p_adjust, percent

analysis settings, as in hdx_results_table().

metadata

named list of extra summary-table items, as in hdx_summary_table().

title

report title.

Dfact

D2O fraction of the labeling buffer, for back-exchange. Default 0.85.

protein_range

residue range for the coverage, as in general_info().

Value

the path of the report, invisibly.

Details

Needs the rmarkdown and knitr packages (and pandoc, which comes with RStudio).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
file_nm <- system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
render_report(file_nm, output_file = file.path(tempdir(), "report.html"),
              regions = list(nterm = c(1, 100), cterm = c(101, 225)))
} # }
